seizure_event.Description: seizure event id from the file name (release eventID)

metric.Description: PDC or imaginary coherence (file name PDC / imcoh)

seizure_type.Description: field sz_type of the file (FAS, FIAS, FBTC, 'Focal, unknown awareness', ...)

awareness_label.Description: field awareness_label as written by the authors

surgery_type.Description: field surgery_type as written by the authors

soz_string.Description: field raw_soz_string (authors' SOZ contacts for this seizure)

n_nodes.Description: number of bipolar nodes (length of bip_labels_used)

n_windows_periictal.Description: windows along the window axis of *_all_windowed

n_windows_interictal.Description: windows along the window axis of *_interictal_windowed
